datasets.name: 04_0_aggregate_summary_table
queryLines:
/* --title 'Aggregates Summary Table' --width 6 --height 6 */
SELECT
  main.recon_id,
  main.source_type,
  main.source_table.`catalog` AS source_catalog,
  main.source_table.`schema` AS source_schema,
  main.source_table.table_name AS source_table_name,
  IF(
    ISNULL(source_catalog),
    CONCAT_WS('.', source_schema, source_table_name),
    CONCAT_WS('.', source_catalog, source_schema, source_table_name)
  ) AS source_table,
  main.target_table.`catalog` AS target_catalog,
  main.target_table.`schema` AS target_schema,
  main.target_table.table_name AS target_table_name,
  CONCAT_WS('.', target_catalog, target_schema, target_table_name) AS target_table,
  UPPER(rules.rule_info.agg_type) || CONCAT('(', rules.rule_info.agg_column, ')') AS aggregate_column,
  rules.rule_info.group_by_columns,
  metrics.run_metrics.status AS status,
  IF(metrics.run_metrics.status, 'PASSED', 'FAILED') AS status_label,
  metrics.run_metrics.exception_message AS exception,
  metrics.recon_metrics.missing_in_source AS missing_in_source,
  metrics.recon_metrics.missing_in_target AS missing_in_target,
  metrics.recon_metrics.mismatch AS mismatch,
  metrics.run_metrics.run_by_user AS executed_by,
  main.start_ts AS start_ts,
  main.end_ts AS end_ts
FROM remorph.reconcile.main AS main
INNER JOIN remorph.reconcile.aggregate_metrics AS metrics
  ON TRUE
INNER JOIN remorph.reconcile.aggregate_rules AS rules
  ON main.recon_table_id = metrics.recon_table_id AND rules.rule_id = metrics.rule_id
ORDER BY
  metrics.inserted_ts DESC,
  main.recon_id,
  main.target_table.table_name

datasets.name: 08_0_aggregate_details_table
queryLines:
/* --title 'Aggregates Reconciliation Details' --width 6 --height 6 */
WITH details_view AS (
  SELECT
    recon_table_id,
    rule_id,
    recon_type,
    source_row AS agg_details
  FROM remorph.reconcile.aggregate_details
), metrics_view AS (
  SELECT
    recon_table_id,
    rule_id,
    recon_metrics,
    run_metrics
  FROM remorph.reconcile.aggregate_metrics
)
SELECT
  recon_id AS dd_recon_id,
  source_table AS dd_source_table,
  target_table AS dd_target_table,
  recon_type AS dd_recon_type,
  aggregate_type AS dd_aggregate_type,
  rule AS aggregate_column,
  source_value,
  target_value,
  TO_JSON(
    MAP_FROM_ARRAYS(
      TRANSFORM(rule_group_by_columns, groupby -> TRIM(groupby)),
      group_by_column_values
    )
  ) AS group_by_columns,
  IF(COALESCE(status, FALSE), 'PASSED', 'FAILED') AS status_label
FROM (
  SELECT
    main.recon_id,
    main.source_table.`catalog` AS source_catalog,
    main.source_table.`schema` AS source_schema,
    main.source_table.table_name AS source_table_name,
    IF(
      ISNULL(source_catalog),
      CONCAT_WS('.', source_schema, source_table_name),
      CONCAT_WS('.', source_catalog, source_schema, source_table_name)
    ) AS source_table,
    main.target_table.`catalog` AS target_catalog,
    main.target_table.`schema` AS target_schema,
    main.target_table.table_name AS target_table_name,
    CONCAT_WS('.', target_catalog, target_schema, target_table_name) AS target_table,
    dtl.recon_type,
    rul.rule_info.agg_type AS aggregate_type,
    UPPER(rul.rule_info.agg_type) || CONCAT('(', rul.rule_info.agg_column, ')') AS rule,
    CONCAT_WS('_', 'source', rul.rule_info.agg_type, rul.rule_info.agg_column) AS source_agg_column,
    TO_JSON(TRY_VARIANT_GET(dtl.agg_details, CONCAT('$["', source_agg_column, '"]'))) AS source_value,
    CONCAT_WS('_', 'target', rul.rule_info.agg_type, rul.rule_info.agg_column) AS target_agg_column,
    TO_JSON(TRY_VARIANT_GET(dtl.agg_details, CONCAT('$["', target_agg_column, '"]'))) AS target_value,
    SPLIT(rul.rule_info.group_by_columns, ',') AS rule_group_by_columns,
    TRANSFORM(
      rule_group_by_columns,
      colm -> COALESCE(
        TRY_VARIANT_GET(dtl.agg_details, CONCAT('$["source_group_by_', TRIM(colm), '"]'), 'string'),
        TRY_VARIANT_GET(dtl.agg_details, CONCAT('$["target_group_by_', TRIM(colm), '"]'), 'string')
      )
    ) AS group_by_column_values,
    CONCAT_WS('_', 'match', rul.rule_info.agg_type, rul.rule_info.agg_column) AS status_column,
    TRY_VARIANT_GET(dtl.agg_details, CONCAT('$["', status_column, '"]'), 'boolean') AS status
  FROM metrics_view AS mtc
  INNER JOIN remorph.reconcile.main AS main
    ON main.recon_table_id = mtc.recon_table_id
  INNER JOIN details_view AS dtl
    ON mtc.recon_table_id = dtl.recon_table_id
  INNER JOIN remorph.reconcile.aggregate_rules AS rul
    ON mtc.rule_id = dtl.rule_id AND dtl.rule_id = rul.rule_id
)
ORDER BY
  recon_id

datasets.name: 10_0_aggr_mismatched_records
queryLines:
/* --title 'Mismatched Records' --width 6 */
SELECT
  main.recon_id,
  CONCAT_WS(
    '.',
    main.target_table.`catalog`,
    main.target_table.`schema`,
    main.target_table.table_name
  ) AS target_table,
  main.start_ts,
  metrics.recon_metrics.mismatch AS mismatch
FROM remorph.reconcile.main AS main
INNER JOIN remorph.reconcile.aggregate_metrics AS metrics
  ON main.recon_table_id = metrics.recon_table_id
ORDER BY
  metrics.inserted_ts DESC,
  main.recon_id,
  main.target_table.table_name
